qualification:
Direct actual-SDK/real-guard-model coupling, with frame checked separately.
Only one SDK operation is paired. Ordinary proof avoids re-instrumenting the
already checked unary counter-only DFCC frames across the two executions.
No SDK function is stubbed; both return actual std guard/ProgramError types.
domain: Same full one-account typed host heap as original contracts: 10MiB storage/all view lengths, arbitrary bytes/metadata, every signed data/lamport count and every nonzero usize Rc header. Exact original SDK and associated real-guard models both execute; real guards dropped between executions and afterward. All enabled checks/covers required.
remaining: Ordinary pair is not a new write-frame certificate: compose the previously verified native/model unary counter-only frames at matching source/ABI pins. General runtime fixture embedding, actual caller/refinement and source child/oracle installation remain separate. No whole S2 closure.
